records.title: Centre fuselage fuel feed installation, main tank to engine feed

interface_breaks.reason: Inherited from the Fuel Feed Sub-system page, which lists Thermal Management for fuel-cooled heat exchangers. No item of this FDPS connects to a heat exchanger: the fuel-cooled oil cooler supply is in another FDPS.

records.title: Usable fuel, main tank
records.statement: The main tank shall provide usable fuel of not less than 420 kg.

records.title: Feed flow at engine interface
records.statement: The fuel feed shall deliver not less than 380 kg/h at the engine interface at an inlet pressure of not less than 35 kPa gauge in all flight conditions.

records.title: Shut-off valve closing time
records.statement: The fuel shut-off valve shall close within 2 s of command.

records.title: Secondary structure bracket strength
records.statement: Secondary structure brackets shall sustain ultimate loads at the design load factors without failure.

records.title: Feed line vibration fatigue
records.statement: Fuel feed line installations shall show no fatigue damage under the installed vibration spectrum for the design life.

records.title: Fire resistance in designated fire zones
records.statement: Propulsion and power system components installed in a designated fire zone shall be fire resistant.

statements.statement: Rigid pipe bends shall have a centreline radius of not less than 3 times the outside diameter.
Flexible hose assemblies shall be supported so that the minimum bend radius is not infringed at full articulation.
Machined internal corner radii shall be not less than 1.5 mm.
Joggles in sheet-metal parts shall have a run-out of not less than 3 times the joggle depth.
Bought-in equipment shall hold an equipment qualification declaration covering the installed environment.
Line-replaceable units shall be removable without disturbing adjacent equipment.
Every component installed in a fuel-wetted or fuel-vapour zone shall be electrically bonded to structure with a resistance of not more than 10 milliohm.
Hydraulic components shall be compatible with the hydraulic fluid specification of the project.
Pneumatic ducts above 200 degrees Celsius shall be lagged where they pass within 50 mm of a fluid line.
Standard Parts shall be procured to the catalogue issue recorded on the Part revision.
Self-locking nuts shall show not less than 1.5 thread pitches of bolt protrusion when installed.
Blind rivets shall not be used in fuel-wetted zones.

records.title: Fire Zone Installations Technical Standards Manual

statements.statement: Components installed in a designated fire zone shall be fire resistant or fireproof as stated in the fire zone schedule.
Designated fire zones shall drain flammable fluid overboard without pooling.

records.title: Feed line fatigue non-compliance, effectivities 1 and 2
records.description: Rev A feed pipe with static-load clamp spacing does not meet D-FUE-FED-011 (VER-D-0000303).
records.limitations: Ground running and flight within the restricted envelope only, with dye-penetrant inspection of the feed pipe every 5 hours.
records.expires: Reviewed every 25 flight hours of each aircraft; withdrawn by the Technical Authority for Design when evidence is accepted that the aircraft has been brought to the rev B standard. That recovery is recorded outside the software until as-embodied configuration is in scope (Requirements Prompt v22, 7.2, 7.4).

records.title: Feed pipe fatigue cracking indication at clamp, effectivity 1 ground running
records.description: Dye-penetrant indication on feed pipe D2822002-001 rev A adjacent to the P-clamp after effectivity 1 ground running. Measured vibration exceeds the static-load basis used for clamp spacing.

resolution.summary: Rev B pipe (CR-D-0000302) and mid-span clamp (CR-D-0000303) from effectivity 3; Concession CON-D-0000001 (with limitations) for effectivities 1 to 2.

records.title: Set feed-line clamp spacing from the installed vibration spectrum
records.summary: Clamp spacing on a fuel feed pipe set from static loads led to a fatigue indication on first ground running.
records.what_happened: Feed pipe rev A cracked adjacent to a P-clamp after ground running of effectivity 1 (ISS-D-0000058).
records.root_cause: The installed vibration spectrum was not available at the B and C reviews; ACT-D-0000102 was closed, and accepted, on static-load evidence.
records.recommendation: Do not accept closure of spacing actions without the installed spectrum or an agreed conservative envelope; make checklist item SA-B-V01 require spectrum evidence.
records.applicability: Rigid pipework supported by clamps in vibration zones.

records.title: Set pipe clamp spacing from the installed vibration spectrum (generic)
records.summary: Clamp spacing set from static loads alone can lead to fatigue of rigid pipework.
records.what_happened: Generic: fatigue indications on rigid pipework adjacent to clamps after first running.
records.root_cause: Installed vibration spectrum not used for clamp spacing.
records.recommendation: Require installed-spectrum evidence, or an agreed conservative envelope, before accepting clamp spacing.
records.applicability: Rigid pipework supported by clamps in vibration zones.
